**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Unsupported global event attribute: {name}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Write global events as `window:onX` / `document:onX` with a capitalized letters-only event name: `window:onResize={…}`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <div window:onclick={() => 1} />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <div window:onClick={() => 1} />;
```
